entries.en: Dammit... I wanna go home...
I don't wanna go to school...[n]This sucks...
I'm so tired every day...
I don't want to go to work...
Are there any[n]breaks coming up?
I heard Mr. Kamoshida[n]got fired...
What's his problem? Casting[n]shame on the school like[n]that...
I wonder who put[n]up those postings.
We have a school assembly?[n]Ugh, what a drag.
I saw the principal[n]talking with someone[n]I didn't recognize.
Exams start today. Boo.
Did you hear? We have a[n]school-wide assembly on[n]the third day.
It's all Kamoshida's fault![n]They should just leave us[n]out of it!
This sucks... I pulled an[n]all-nighter last night.
What are they thinking,[n]holding an assembly in[n]the middle of exams?
A school-wide assembly,[n]at this time of year?[n]Really?
Think we can bring[n]our flash cards in?
Kamoshida is just[n]one of the many things[n]wrong with this school...
I've got to hurry[n]home and study!
That Kamoshida is[n]still causing us trouble,[n]even when he's gone...
Finally done with exams...
Hey, are you gonna[n]go in for counseling?
I saw the volleyball[n]guys getting called in...
Oh shit, I got that[n]question wrong!
I know, right? I feel like I[n]have to protect that teacher!
So, was that calling card[n]just a prank after all?
Wanna stop by Shibuya on the way[n]home? I've gotta see that exhibit.
What if it was[n]you who did it!?
Apparently the student council[n]president is investigating it.
It's already over,[n]right? Who cares...
All the news on[n]Kaneshiro has distracted[n]me from studying.
So what if she's an honor[n]student? Why should she[n]get special treatment?
Results are what[n]matter, you know?
I heard the Phantom[n]Thieves might be from[n]our school!
That can't be true.[n]It'd be funny if[n]it was though...
Medjed? Those guys[n]that claim to be modern-[n]day Robin Hoods?
They dare call[n]themselves heroes after[n]those attacks? Pfft.
They're fighting[n]Medjed next!? The Phantom[n]Thieves are amazing!
I don't wanna hear[n]about justice from some[n]shady hackers.
I don't care what happens,[n]as long as it's interesting!
An assembly during summer[n]vacation? Are they crazy?
Our school's[n]done for...
I don't care what the[n]principal has to say.
They're so stupid![n]I wish I could change[n]their hearts.
Why not make a post? Our[n]request might be taken...
Huh? What about class?
There's another[n]urgent assembly...
Is it true he died?
He was really[n]taking some heat...
What's happening to this[n]school!? Are we cursed?
Was Okumura...[n]murdered?
But that was a live[n]broadcast, wasn't it?
If it wasn't an illness...[n]then it has to be murder!
Did something happen to[n]the honor student? She[n]seems different now...
Still, I feel bad for him,[n]going out like that...
Have we been cheering on[n]murderers all this time...?
It has to be a setup![n]The Phantom Thieves[n]aren't like that...
They have to endure that[n]harsh training everyday? I[n]feel a bit sorry for them...
I believe in the[n]Phantom Thieves! They[n]wouldn't do that...
Oh, the gymnast girl?[n]Yeah, she's changed in[n]a good way.
Did you hear[n]those rumors?
She's so lucky. It's almost[n]like her test scores don't[n]matter...
I wonder if they really[n]are from our school...
The teachers are doing[n]a 180 on the honor[n]student...
She's on the podium![n]Good for her!
The police are[n]here AGAIN?
How many times has[n]this been, now?
Our school's gotten[n]famous for all the[n]wrong reasons...
They revoked her[n]honors status!? This school[n]is so messed up...
I wonder if the culprit[n]really is from our school...
Dr. Maruki's leaving?[n]Are you kidding me?
This is SO sad...
I think I know who the[n]Phantom Thieves are...
If we report them, will[n]we get 30 million yen?
Wanna just report anyone[n]who seems suspicious?
One cleanup event[n]isn't going to improve[n]the school's image.
What? She's exempt from[n]the cleanup? How precious[n]is this honor student?
We have to go to[n]Inokashira Park in our[n]stupid gym clothes?
She's not coming, right?[n]I wish I could ditch this[n]event, too...
We're meeting at[n]Inokashira Park? I'd[n]better remember that...
I hear this incredible[n]first-year came!
Wow, that girl in the[n]ribbon is really thin.[n]Is she a first-year?
The delinquent and the[n]honor student, arriving at[n]the same time? Uh-oh...
Assault, blackmail, drugs...[n]He's done it all.
I hear he carries[n]around a knife...
He got in trouble on[n]the first day of school...
Those guys are[n]getting expelled...
Nobody wants a[n]troublemaker in school...
Everyone's got high[n]hopes for the new girl,[n]Yoshizawa-chan.
Damn, she's fine.[n]I wonder if I have[n]a shot with her...
That delinquent moves fast.
I heard she has to return[n]to practice right after this.
Why did they let that guy[n]in school in the first place...
I'm not getting near him...
I wish he would just get[n]expelled. Who needs him...
The Madarame exhibit is[n]great! You gotta go see it!
I've been feeling[n]pretty down lately. Maybe I[n]should go to counseling...
I never knew that art[n]could be so... explosive!
Have you been to[n]counseling yet?
Huh. The Madarame[n]exhibit, eh? When is it[n]until?
I didn't think she[n]would come... Oh, maybe[n]she's skipping practice.
I hate those events. All[n]they do is make me dirty[n]and tired...
Think they'll do it[n]again next year? If they[n]are, I'm definitely skipping...
Why'd the goody-two-shoes[n]first-year come along?
Her whole "I'm not[n]bothered" routine really[n]pisses me off sometimes.
She's cute! And I hear[n]she's practicing hard.
Should we tell Miss[n]President? It's so unfair[n]that she gets special treatment!
Well, it doesn't really[n]concern me...
Student Council?[n]What's going on?
I wish I were an honor[n]student! I don't wanna[n]have to pay tuition!
Medjed...? What is[n]happening to this[n]country?
It'd be hilarious if the honor[n]student fell off the podium...
Is it over for the[n]Phantom Thieves?
Hacking? I have no[n]idea what that's like,[n]but it sounds scary.
I think they were[n]getting a little cocky. They got[n]what was coming for them.
They ought to be able[n]to crush a bunch of[n]hackers.
Phantom thieves can[n]hack into computers,[n]can't they?
She probably half-assed[n]her practice.
Where are these[n]so-called hackers,[n]anyway?
I still have to go to[n]the Nurse's Office...
The vice principal[n]seems pretty on[n]edge these days...
Someone in my class got[n]her recommendation canceled[n]by the vice principal!
The vice principal's[n]been running his mouth[n]lately. It's annoying.
They're gonna give[n]us hell if we don't[n]win next time!
Another tournament's[n]coming up... We have no[n]chance of winning, though.
You think the Phantom[n]Thieves are freaking out?
I wrote "Okumura," too![n]I hope they'll handle it[n]quickly.
I hear he's really corrupt![n]If anyone needs a change[n]of heart, it's him.
The board of directors[n]is putting pressure on[n]the vice principal.
There's something[n]seriously wrong with[n]the vice principal...
I wish he'd at least stay[n]until we graduate...
The Phantom Thieves[n]are students from our[n]school, right?
What? Who is it!?
I was seriously in love[n]with Dr. Maruki...
No point in going to[n]the nurse's office now.
My shoulder? It's fine.[n]Why do you ask, coach?
May I take the extra classes as well?[n]I want to study more!
This class is so awesome.[n]There's no bullying or[n]anything like that here.
My bad, I have club today[n]after school. You guys can[n]go home without me.
Huh? Club? I thought he was in the[n]"go home" club...
You got accepted[n]too? Let's party!
My mom's in a good[n]mood these days. It's[n]so peaceful at home.
My parents gave me[n]permission to study[n]abroad!
This class was so nice. I[n]don't want to graduate...
Time for obligatory[n]chocolate already? But[n]it's not even Valentine's!
